_meta.description: All certification standards and legislation applicable to Abagold Processing Facility
_meta.sourceFolder: 1. Food Safety Management System/FSSC 22000/14. Legislation and Guidelines
_meta.agentInstructions: Read this file to understand all active certification obligations. Each entry has a 'status' field (active/monitoring/expired), 'nextAction' date, and 'affectedRecords' linking to the REC codes in the processing system. Use 'category' to group compliance tasks.

certifications.name: FSSC 22000 Food Safety System Certification
certifications.scope: Food manufacturing — abalone processing (dried, canned, live)
certifications.notes: Version 7 is current scheme. Key new requirements include food safety culture, food loss & waste. Development Program V2.0 May 2025 applies.

certifications.name: ISO 22000:2018 — Food Safety Management Systems
certifications.scope: FSMS standard — underpins FSSC 22000 certification
certifications.notes: Core FSMS standard. All procedures and records must satisfy clause requirements (context, leadership, planning, support, operation, evaluation, improvement).

certifications.name: ISO/TS 22002-1:2009 — Prerequisite Programmes (PRPs) for Food Manufacturing
certifications.scope: PRP technical specification for food manufacturing
certifications.notes: Covers infrastructure, cleaning, pest control, personal hygiene, allergen management, etc.

certifications.name: SANS 10330 — HACCP System Requirements
certifications.scope: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points — all processing lines
certifications.notes: FSMS Calendar includes annual HACCP audit. CCPs include temperature control (chiller, incubator, dry room).

certifications.name: SANS 10049 — Prerequisite Programmes for Food Safety
certifications.scope: PRPs — food safety pre-conditions for the facility
certifications.notes: South African PRP standard; used alongside ISO/TS 22002-1.

certifications.name: SANS 241 — Drinking Water Quality
certifications.scope: Potable water used in processing
certifications.frequency: Monthly micro testing; annual chemical SANS 241 compliance
sourceFiles: South African National StandardDrinking Water Quality SANS 241  2024).pdf
certifications.notes: FSMS Calendar tracks monthly water micro testing and annual SANS 241 verification.

certifications.name: SANS 2329:2019 — Dried Abalone
certifications.scope: Dried abalone product specification
certifications.notes: Defines grade criteria, moisture limits, labelling requirements for dried abalone.

certifications.name: SANS 587:2017 — Canned Aquatic Products
certifications.scope: Canned abalone (braised, minced, natural)
certifications.notes: Covers can integrity, fill weights, micro limits for canned abalone products.

certifications.name: SANS 729:2018 — Live Aquaculture Products
certifications.scope: Live abalone — holding, packing, transport
certifications.notes: Quality and safety requirements for live abalone packing and export.

certifications.name: SANS 585 — Frozen Aquatic Products
certifications.scope: Frozen abalone products
certifications.notes: May apply to frozen product lines. Verify if frozen product is currently active.

certifications.name: Regulation R638 — Regulations Governing General Hygiene Requirements for Food Premises
certifications.scope: All food processing premises and staff hygiene
certifications.notes: Core hygiene regulation for food premises under the Foodstuffs Act. Covers staff, equipment, structure.

certifications.name: Foodstuffs, Cosmetics and Disinfectants Act 54 of 1972
certifications.scope: All food products — manufacture, labelling, sale
certifications.notes: Umbrella food law in South Africa. Reviewed Feb 2026 — check for any new R-notices or amendments.

certifications.name: Agricultural Product Standards Act 119 of 1990
certifications.scope: Grading, packing and marking of abalone products for sale
certifications.notes: Governs compulsory specs (VC notices) for agricultural products. Reviewed Feb 2026.

certifications.name: National Health Act 61 of 2003
certifications.scope: Environmental health, occupational health, medicals
certifications.notes: Covers employee health screening and environmental health obligations.

certifications.name: VC 9108:2025 — Compulsory Specification for Canned Abalone
certifications.scope: Canned abalone products
certifications.frequency: Per batch / NRCS letter of authority
certifications.notes: NRCS compulsory spec — Letter of Authority required before canned product can be sold. Updated 2025.

certifications.name: VC 9001 — Compulsory Specification (General / Abalone)
certifications.scope: Verify exact product scope from document
certifications.notes: Review document to confirm product scope. May overlap with VC 9108.

certifications.name: VC 8014 — Compulsory Specification for Canned Fish, Canned Marine Molluscs and Canned Crustaceans
certifications.scope: Canned marine products
certifications.notes: Compulsory spec covering canned marine products; may apply alongside VC 9108.

certifications.name: DFFE — Aquaculture Permit & PST Control
certifications.scope: Aquaculture operation, harvest, PST monitoring
certifications.certBody: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE)
certifications.frequency: Annual permit renewal; PST testing per season
certifications.notes: PST (Paralytic Shellfish Toxin) testing required before and during harvest season. DFFE sets control periods.

certifications.name: Aquaculture Management Food Safety Programme (AMFFSP)
certifications.scope: Food safety programme for aquaculture — mandatory for export
certifications.frequency: Annual programme compliance; inspection by DFFE
certifications.notes: Required for EU and other export markets. Signed Nov 2025 — confirm current programme year validity.

certifications.name: ISO 19011:2018 — Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems
certifications.scope: Internal audit programme
sourceFiles: STANDARDS_Scheme Requirements/ISO-19011-2018 Guidelines for Auditing Management.pdf
certifications.notes: Guides how internal audits are planned and conducted. FSMS Calendar tracks internal audit schedule.

certifications.name: Codex Alimentarius — General Standard for Food Additives (CXS 192)
certifications.scope: Food additives used in processing
certifications.notes: Reference standard for permissible food additives and maximum levels. 2024 edition now available.

certifications.name: Codex Standard for Dried Abalone (CXS 312)
certifications.scope: Dried abalone product — international trade standard
certifications.notes: Key standard for export markets. Aligns with SANS 2329 but check for differences in grade limits.

certifications.name: Draft Labelling Regulations R3337 (2023) + R146
certifications.scope: All pre-packaged food products sold in South Africa
certifications.notes: R3337 is the new draft labelling regulation — not yet promulgated. R146 remains in force. Watch for implementation date — will affect all labels.

certifications.name: GACC — China Registration for Overseas Manufacture
certifications.scope: Export of abalone products to China
certifications.certBody: GACC (General Administration of Customs China) / DFFE
certifications.frequency: Registration renewal as required by GACC
sourceFiles: China/GACC Registration for Overseas Manufacture - Chinese and English Abagold Ltd.doc
China/China Measures on the Administration of Inspection and Quarantine of Inward Aquatic Animals.doc
China Releases the Standard for Maximum Levels of Contaminants in Foods_GB 2762.pdf
certifications.notes: Abagold must maintain GACC registration to export to China. DFFE is the competent authority. China contaminant limits (GB 2762) apply to product.

certifications.name: Hong Kong Food Safety Ordinance — CAP 132
certifications.scope: Export of abalone products to Hong Kong
certifications.certBody: Centre for Food Safety (CFS), Hong Kong
certifications.notes: Hong Kong food safety law. Verify import requirements for dried/canned abalone.

certifications.name: Canada — CFIA Labelling Regulations
certifications.scope: Export of abalone products to Canada
certifications.notes: Canadian bilingual labelling and import requirements apply for Canada market.

certifications.name: Microbiological Guidelines for Food (SANS / Codex)
certifications.scope: Micro testing limits for finished products and environmental swabs
certifications.notes: Reference for setting micro limits in FSMS. Used for water swabs, abalone, drain swabs as per FSMS Calendar.
